Admissions
Students interested in the M.S. or Ph.D. in Geosciences should register their interest
at choosegrad.ttu.edu. The link provides more information about the graduate program as well as a description
of the documents required for preparing an application.
Admission to the graduate program in Geosciences is contingent upon:
1) admission by the Graduate School at Texas Tech and
2) admission by the Department of Geosciences.
Frequently Asked Questions
To submit an application, please visit the Graduate School admissions portal.
APPLY NOW at Prospective Students - How to Apply
For full consideration, complete applications for spring semester should be received
by October 15, 2026. If you have any questions, please email Branimir.Segvic@ttu.edu.
Academic Programs
The Geology and Geophysics Program in the Department of Geosciences offers a rigorous
graduate program that leads to a Master of Science degree in Geosciences or a Doctor
of Philosophy degree in Geosciences.
Master of Science in Geosciences (MS GEOS)
Ph.D. in Geosciences (geology or geophysics)
Research
The Geology and Geophysics Program at Texas Tech University is strongly committed
to both teaching and research in the geosciences. Major areas of research include,
but are not limited to, the following:
Geochemistry
Geophysics
Minerology and Petrology
Paleontology and Biostratigraphy
Planetary Science
Sedimentology and Stratigraphy
Structural Geology and Tectonics
